mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpDsPckpaprDesignRejectStatePopList*/ SELECT ROWNUM AS SEQ, X.* FROM( SELECT (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = RETURN_USER_ID) AS RETURN_USER_NAME, DECODE(RETURN_USER_DEPT,'MK','마케팅팀','PD','상품개발 팀','QA','품질보증 팀') AS RETURN_USER_DEPT, TO_CHAR(RETURN_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS')AS RETURN_DATE, RETURN_REMARK, DECODE(RETURN_REMARK, '', '0','1') AS RETURN_REMARK_IMG FROM DONGOPKG_HISTORY WHERE PLANT =#{st_plant} AND BYCA_COMORG_CODE =#{st_byca_comorg_code} AND BUYER =#{st_buyer} AND OPKG_SEQ =#{st_opkg_seq} AND RD_DATE =#{st_rd_date} AND BUYER_ITEM_NO =#{st_buyer_item_no} ORDER BY RETURN_DATE,RETURN_USER_DEPT,RETURN_USER_ID ) X
